explanation: In component form, NRR = 100 x (starting MRR - cancelled - downgrades + upgrades) / starting MRR = 100 x (40,000 - 3,000 - 1,000 + 6,200) / 40,000 = 100 x 42,200 / 40,000 = 105.5%. The €9,000 from new businesses stays out, because only the starting businesses form the cohort; adding it would give 128.0%.
